description: HTTP and SSH access by pico user across pgs, prose, pastes, pipe and tuns.

panels.description: Users with at least one HTTP request in the time range.
panels.title: Active users

targets.expr: count(sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.description: HTTP requests attributed to a user. Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.
panels.title: Requests

targets.expr: sum(increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Response body bytes attributed to a user. Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.
panels.title: Data served

targets.expr: sum(increase(pico_http_response_bytes_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.description: SSH sessions started by a user.
panels.title: SSH sessions

targets.expr: sum(increase(pssh_sessions_created_total{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.description: The users with the most requests over the whole time range. Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.
panels.title: Requests per second by user (top $topn)

targets.expr: sum by (user) (rate(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (user) topk($topn, sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

panels.description: The users with the most response bytes over the whole time range. Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.
panels.title: Bytes served per second by user (top $topn)

targets.expr: sum by (user) (rate(pico_http_response_bytes_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (user) topk($topn, sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_response_bytes_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

panels.title: Users
panels.description: Totals for the time range, one row per user. Sort by any column. Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.

targets.expr: sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))
sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_response_bytes_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

(sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) / sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

(sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))) / sum by (user) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (user, le) (rate(pico_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])))
count by (user) (sum by (user, app) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0)
sum by (user) (increase(pssh_sessions_created_total{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range]))

panels.description: Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.
panels.title: Requests per second by service

targets.expr: sum by (app) (rate(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]))
sum by (class) (label_replace(rate(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval]), "class", "${1}xx", "status", "([0-9])[0-9][0-9]"))

panels.description: Measured inside the app, from request to the last byte written.
panels.title: p95 latency by service

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (app, le) (rate(pico_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: Across every selected service and user.
panels.title: Latency for the selection

targets.expr: histogram_quantile(0.5, sum by (le) (rate(pico_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.95, sum by (le) (rate(pico_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))
histogram_quantile(0.99, sum by (le) (rate(pico_http_request_duration_seconds_bucket{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])))

panels.description: The most requested over the whole time range. A pgs project or a tuns tunnel's hostname. Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.
panels.title: Requests per second by project or tunnel (top $topn)

targets.expr: sum by (app, user, resource) (rate(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__rate_interval])) and on (app, user, resource) topk($topn, sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

panels.description: The most bytes served over the whole time range. A pgs project or a tuns tunnel's hostname. Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.
panels.title: Bytes served per second by project or tunnel (top $topn)

targets.expr: sum by (app, user, resource) (rate(pico_http_response_bytes_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__rate_interval])) and on (app, user, resource) topk($topn, sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_response_bytes_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

panels.title: Projects and tunnels (top 100)
panels.description: Totals for the time range. A pgs project or a tuns tunnel's hostname. Includes pgs-cdn when selected. CDN cache misses are also counted by pgs, so deselect pgs-cdn to count each request once.

targets.expr: topk(100, sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_response_bytes_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range])) and on (app, user, resource) topk(100, sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range])) > 0)

(sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!="", status=~"5.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range]))) / sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range])) and on (app, user, resource) topk(100, sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range])) > 0)

(sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!="", status=~"4.."}[$__range])) or 0 * sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range]))) / sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range])) and on (app, user, resource) topk(100, sum by (app, user, resource) (increase(pico_http_requests_total{app=~"$app", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance", resource!=""}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.description: Sessions started in each interval of the graph.
panels.title: SSH sessions started by user (top $topn)

targets.expr: sum by (user) (increase(pssh_sessions_created_total{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval])) and on (user) topk($topn, sum by (user) (increase(pssh_sessions_created_total{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

panels.description: Sessions started in each interval of the graph.
panels.title: SSH sessions started by service

targets.expr: sum by (app) (increase(pssh_sessions_created_total{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval]))

panels.description: Time spent in SSH sessions. A session counts in the interval it ends, so open sessions don't show yet.
panels.title: SSH session time by user (top $topn)

targets.expr: sum by (user) (increase(pssh_sessions_duration_seconds{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__interval])) and on (user) topk($topn, sum by (user) (increase(pssh_sessions_duration_seconds{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

panels.title: SSH sessions by user and command (top 50)
panels.description: Totals for the time range. The command is the first word of what the user ran. Time counts sessions that ended in the range.

targets.expr: topk(50, sum by (user, app, command) (increase(pssh_sessions_created_total{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0)

sum by (user, app, command) (increase(pssh_sessions_duration_seconds{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) and on (user, app, command) topk(50, sum by (user, app, command) (increase(pssh_sessions_created_total{app=~"($app)-ssh", user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range])) > 0)

panels.description: Users with the most tunnel time over the range. From tuns, which ignores the Service filter. The user is the SSH login name.
panels.title: Active tunnels by user (top $topn)

targets.expr: count by (user) (sish_tunnels_active{user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}) and on (user) topk($topn, sum by (user) (count_over_time(sish_tunnels_active{user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())) > 0)

panels.description: Bytes in both directions through every kind of tunnel. A proxied connection counts when it closes. From tuns, which ignores the Service filter. The user is the SSH login name.
panels.title: Tunnel traffic by user (top $topn)

targets.expr: sum by (user) (rate(sish_bytes_received_total{user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) + sum by (user) (rate(sish_bytes_transmitted_total{user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__rate_interval])) and on (user) topk($topn, (sum by (user) (increase(sish_bytes_received_total{user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end())) + sum by (user) (increase(sish_bytes_transmitted_total{user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"}[$__range] @ end()))) > 0)

panels.title: Open tunnels
panels.description: Tunnels open now. The tunnel is the name and port the client asked to bind. From tuns, which ignores the Service filter. The user is the SSH login name.

targets.expr: count by (user, type, tunnel) (sish_tunnels_active{user=~"$user", instance=~"$instance"})

panels.title: Deployed servers
panels.description: The server and commit behind each scrape target.

targets.expr: pico_server_info{app=~"$app|($app)-ssh", instance=~"$instance"}
